name: Primalist Magma Fissure knocks an enemy on the right of the line further right (#12302)
contract: #12302 Magma Fissure: the tooltip says the wave 'knocks all enemies to the side'. Effect 1 of every rank is
SPELL_EFFECT_SCRIPT_EFFECT with MiscValue 15 and MiscValueB 5 and had no script. Maintainer decision: each
enemy is knocked away from the fissure's centre line, the caster's facing, towards the side it stands on,
using the effect's values as horizontal speed 15 and vertical speed 5 (about 7.8 yards); an enemy exactly on
the line goes to the caster's right. Here the caster faces +x (orientation 0) and the target stands 8 yards
ahead and 1 yard to the caster's right, so it must move -y by several yards while staying near its x.
TARGET_UNIT_CONE_ENEMY_24 selects a 24 degree cone, so the target has to stay within 12 degrees of the

steps.label: SETUP: Magma Fissure hit the target
DISCRIMINATING: the target was knocked to the right
the knockback is sideways, not away from the caster
